deadline.value: Graduate Catalog admissions policies list Biological Sciences Ph.D. Fall admission only as August 1 - November 15; however, the Biological Sciences Ph.D. catalog entry itself states rolling admission with all documents due July 1 for Fall (December 1 for Spring/Summer).
deadline.quote: Biological Sciences Doctoral Program | Fall Admission only August 1 - November 15

also.quote: There is no priority deadline. Admission is done by a rolling deadline, and all documents must be submitted by July 1st for the FALL semester, and December 1st for the SPRING and SUMMER semesters.

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Subject Test in May 2021; the department states no subject test requirement.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admissions decisions are made by the Departmental admissions committee based on application materials and interviews with selected applicants; pre-admission supervisor agreement is not explicitly stated.

funding.value: Graduate Assistantships (~20 hours/week in research, teaching, or administration) provide a monthly stipend and most include tuition and fees; Title III doctoral assistantships pay $3,000/month plus in-state tuition for up to 4 years (POTUS Fellowships are U.S. citizen/permanent resident only).
funding.quote: Graduate Assistants are required to work approximately 20 hours per week. ... Appointments provide a monthly stipend and most include tuition and fees.

also.quote: $3,000 monthly stipend for doctoral students | In-state tuition while under contract | Doctoral students are eligible for up to 4 years maximum of support

entry_route.value: Requires a bachelor's degree (3.0+ GPA) with at least 24 acceptable semester hours in biology and prerequisite science/math courses; students entering with a master's degree may transfer up to 30 applicable credits toward the 76-credit Ph.D.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are required to have accumulated a minimum of 24 acceptable semester hours in biology plus a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university with a GPA of 3.0 or higher

notes: Requires Cell Biology, General Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, Pre-Calculus or higher, Physics, and Statistics prerequisites plus 3 letters of recommendation and personal statement.
name: Biological Sciences, Ph.D.
